Account deletion requests

Bounty accepts account and associated-data deletion requests at kunal26das@gmail.com. In Android, open Your corner → Request account deletion to read these instructions and compose an email. You can also request directly without reinstalling Bounty or creating another account.

Support handles requests manually and independently verifies ownership before changes. Opening the email composer does not send automatically. A drafted or sent request, signing out, uninstalling or removing local files does not confirm account deletion. You receive the actual result and any retained-data explanation separately.

Automatic Cloud cleanup is unavailable. Support checks for any existing hosted data associated with the account as part of manual handling. If a system or record cannot yet be inspected or removed, we explain the unfinished work and do not report the request complete.

How to request account or data deletion

Email kunal26das@gmail.com with the subject Bounty account deletion or Bounty data request. State whether you want the account and associated data removed, a copy of data or help removing particular data. Include the sign-in provider, platform and account email shown in Bounty if available. The Support ID can help locate the account but is not proof of ownership.

Do not send a Google password, sign-in code, ID/access/refresh token, full card details or private ledger. Support confirms ownership using contact details independently checked against the account or another appropriate verification method. An incoming address, display name, screenshot or purchase reference alone does not authorize deletion.

We aim to acknowledge within 7 calendar days and handle the request within 30 days. We explain additional verification, provider steps, legitimate retention or delays. These aims do not guarantee that every provider completes erasure within that period and do not limit applicable rights.

You may export records and keep original receipts before removal; this is optional and not a condition for requesting deletion. Deleting the Bounty account can end access to its identity and Pro. It does not cancel a Google Play subscription; manage renewal separately with Google Play.

What account handling covers

After verification, support checks the exact Firebase account, RevenueCat customer identifiers and aliases, configured downstream integrations and any pre-existing hosted Bounty account data. We remove records under our control that are associated with the account, subject to specific legitimate retention explained in the result. Firebase account deletion does not delete your Google account.

Deleting a RevenueCat customer does not cancel the Google Play subscription or erase Google Play order records. Provider security, transaction and backup retention is handled separately. We distinguish an accepted removal operation from confirmed completion and do not use temporary account disablement as a substitute for deletion.

We do not assume that all RevenueCat aliases belong to one person, or that relabelling a participant removes personal information. If historical shared records contain personal text or identifiers, support reviews that data and any specific necessary retention. Unrelated personal information is not retained indefinitely merely to preserve a display name or financial total. The actual scope, reason and duration or retention criteria are explained to the requester.

Crashlytics diagnostics use installation and session identifiers; Bounty does not attach your account identity. Account deletion does not by itself identify or immediately erase those reports held by Google. See the privacy policy for Google’s crash-data retention process, and contact support about an applicable data request.

Retention of request records

Raw diagnostic attachments are deleted 30 days after request closure. A minimal ordinary-support summary is retained for 12 months after closure to follow up recurring issues and document the response. Account-deletion requests also cover those account-associated support records unless a specific legitimate retention need applies. A separate minimal verification or deletion record is kept for 90 days after completion to protect against unauthorized account changes and resolve questions about the handling; the same deletion request does not receive a duplicate 12-month support record. Reusable passwords or tokens are not requested or retained as proof.

Only necessary records are retained longer for an active dispute, a security or fraud-prevention need, or a legal obligation. We document the specific reason and review when it ends. Privacy policy describes the remaining account, provider and device-data limits.

Local records and exported copies

Local and Demo workspaces are separate from the signed-in account. Removing that account does not remotely erase them. To remove local Android records, use app-data controls after saving anything you need; sign out first when possible.

Exports, original receipt files and copies held by other people are independent copies. Remove them from their saved locations or ask recipients where appropriate. Account deletion cannot remotely erase an exported copy on another device.

Prepare a deletion request email ↗

Opens your email app. Review the message before sending; no request is submitted by this page. Sending a message does not confirm deletion or cancel a subscription.
